states.meaning: The step ran and produced valid geometry.
The step ran, but something needs attention, such as a fillet radius that was reduced or text that runs past the face.
The step did not run; the model continues without it. The failure code says why and how to fix it.
The step was not run because it refers to something a failed or suppressed step would have created.
The step is turned off. It stays in the script and can be turned back on.
The step is saved but has not been built yet.

actions.title: Body
actions.summary: Add a new labelled part from a box, rounded box, cylinder, cone or sphere.
actions.description: Use for the blocks, bases and plinths a deal toy starts from. The step name becomes the part label, and the part gets named sides (top, bottom, left, right, front, back) for later steps. Do not use it to cut material: use extrude with operation cut, hole, or combine.

size.description: Box size along X, Y and Z

radius.description: Edge radius of a rounded box

diameter.description: Diameter of a cylinder or sphere, or the bottom diameter of a cone

top_diameter.description: Top diameter of a cone; 0 makes a point

height.description: Height of a cylinder or cone

at.description: Where the centre of the body's bottom sits, in model coordinates

on.description: Optional face or plane the body stands on; its bottom is placed on it, centred at the projection of at

failures.fix: Move the reference point closer to the intended face, or pick it by a created name.

actions.title: Construction plane

actions.description: Use to place features where no face exists, such as text floating on a mid-plane or a cut through the middle of a part. A plane adds no material. Later steps refer to it with m.datum(name).

angle.description: Rotation about the edge, for method angle

actions.title: Extrude
actions.summary: Extrude a rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle, slot or polygon from a face to add, cut or make a part.
actions.description: Use for pockets, bosses, slots and recesses with a simple outline. Use hole for round holes with counterbores or countersinks, text for lettering, and combine to cut one existing part from another. Negative distances go into the part.

width.description: Profile width along the face's horizontal direction

length.description: Profile length along the face's vertical direction

radius.description: Corner radius of a rounded rectangle

diameter.description: Diameter of a circle, or of the circle around a polygon

at.description: A point in model coordinates, projected onto the face; defaults to the face's centre

rotation.description: Rotation of the profile about the face normal

extent.description: How far to go: a distance, a distance split both ways, through the whole part, or up to a face

distance.description: Distance along the face normal; negative goes into the part

up_to.description: The face to stop at when extent is up_to

taper.description: Draft angle of the side walls; positive narrows away from the face

operation.description: Make a new part named after the step, add to the target, or cut from it

target.description: The part to join to or cut from; defaults to the part that owns the face

creates.end: The end face opposite the starting face
creates.sides: The side walls of the extrusion

actions.title: Revolve
actions.summary: Spin a closed profile of radius and height points around a vertical axis to make a round part.
actions.description: Use for round bodies: cup walls, bowls, foot rings, knobs and rolled lips. The profile is a list of (r, z) points from the axis outward, closed automatically and revolved about the vertical axis through at. Points may read PARAMS with mt.P. Not for straight prisms (use extrude) or shapes that change outline between heights (use loft).

profile.description: The outline as (r, z) points: distance from the axis and height

items.description: r, the distance from the axis, then z, the height

smooth.description: Draw a smooth curve through the points instead of straight lines

angle.description: How far to revolve; 360 makes a full ring

at.description: A point on the vertical axis, in model coordinates; defaults to the origin

actions.title: Loft
actions.summary: Blend between horizontal outlines at increasing heights, such as a round base rising to an oval rim.
actions.description: Use when the outline changes with height: a cup body that is round at the foot and oval at the rim, or a tapered plinth. Each section is a circle, ellipse, rectangle or rounded rectangle centred on the vertical axis through at, at height z. For one outline revolved round an axis use revolve; for a constant outline use extrude.

ruled.description: Join the outlines with straight sides instead of a smooth blend

actions.title: Custom step
actions.summary: Run a saved custom action, or a Python function from this script, for anything the other actions do not cover.
actions.description: Give exactly one of action= (a saved action as id@version, listed by actions_list; its own inputs follow) or fn= (a top-level function in this script, defined outside the steps section as def name(m, **inputs), returning a dict of created names to faces). Every other keyword argument is passed on. Prefer a saved action; save a function you need twice with actions_save.
